name: Click-evoked auditory brainstem responses, one listener
source: OpenNeuro ds005340 v1.0.4 (Polonenko & Maddox), sub-01, the 90 click trials
attribution: Polonenko, M. J., & Maddox, R. K. (2024). Fundamental frequency predominantly drives talker differences in auditory brainstem responses to continuous speech. JASA Express Letters, 4(11), 114401. Data: OpenNeuro ds005340, CC0.
reduction: reduce.py: channel A1 (left earlobe, reference FCz), 30–2000 Hz zero-phase band-pass per 10 s trial, average of −5…20 ms epochs around every left-ear click (one row per trial); control rows use the next trial's click times. Displayed at 5 kHz.
